title: Registrations
lead: One form per activity (retreat, concert, catechism, outing). People register from the site; you see who is coming, who is waiting, and you check people in on arrival. Their details are deleted automatically a few months after the activity.
empty_p: Create a form for an activity: it appears on the site as soon as you publish it.
delete_p: All its registrations are deleted with it; only anonymous totals are kept. This cannot be undone.
retention_on: On {date}, the names and numbers of this form are erased. Only anonymous totals remain.
retention_help: A registration’s data is kept 6 months after the activity, and at most 12 months after the form closed. After that day it is deleted automatically; there is nothing to do. Export before then if you need it.
to_tell_p: A place opened up: call them or write on WhatsApp, then click “Told”.
add_help: For a registration made by phone or on paper. The person agreed out loud: this will be noted.
people_empty_p: Registrations appear here as soon as the form is published.
delete_person_p: Do this at the person’s request. Their name and number are erased for good.
checkin_help: Tap a name when the person arrives. No phone number is shown here.
err_bad_whatsapp: The WhatsApp number is not valid.
err_guardian_required: You must be a parent or guardian to register a child.
err_answers: An answer is missing or not valid.
f_event_date_help: The deletion countdown starts from this day.
f_capacity_help: Leave empty for no limit. Children count.
f_minors_help: The person registering must be the parent or guardian (required tick box). Children are recorded by first name and age band only.
f_fields_help: A few questions the organisers need (meal, t-shirt size…). You cannot ask about health, origin, religion, politics or money: only write what you need.
f_always: Always asked: name, phone, number of people. People tick an agreement box.
f_options_help: At least two choices. Enter confirms; click a choice to edit it.
f_sensitive: This question touches a subject we do not ask about here (health, origin, religion, politics, money). Rephrase or remove it.

site.title: Registration
site.not_found_p: It does not exist, or it is no longer open.
site.state_not_yet_p: Registrations are not open yet. Come back a little later.
site.state_closed_p: Registrations for this activity are over.
site.state_full_p: There is no place left for this activity.
site.spots_full: Full: you will be put on the waitlist
site.members_only: This registration is for members only.
site.f_phone_help: With or without +237: we reach you there, on WhatsApp if needed.
site.children_p: For each child: first name and age band, nothing else. Leave the extra lines empty.
site.guardian: I am the legal parent or guardian of these children.
site.consent: I agree that my details are used for this registration and to reach me if something changes.
site.consent_p: They are kept for {months} months after the activity, then deleted. They are used for nothing else and never shared.
site.err_consent: Tick the agreement box to continue.
site.err_bad_phone: This number is not valid. Example: 6 77 12 34 56.
site.err_bad_whatsapp: The WhatsApp number is not valid.
site.err_guardian_required: You must be the parent or guardian to register a child: tick the box.
site.err_answers: An answer is missing or not valid.
site.err_duplicate: This number is already registered for this activity.
site.err_too_fast: One moment, then try again: the form was sent too fast.
site.err_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a while.
site.err_members_only: This registration is for members only: sign in first.
site.done_p: It is noted for “{title}”. We will write to you if something changes.
site.wait_p: You are number {n}. If a place opens, someone from the parish will tell you by phone.
site.keep_code: Keep it: it helps if you call us.
site.privacy_kept: Your details are deleted {months} months after the activity.
site.cancel_ask: {name}, do you really want to cancel your registration for “{title}”?
site.cancelled_p: Thank you for letting us know. Your place will go to someone else.
site.link_bad_p: This link has expired or is not correct. Call the parish to cancel your registration.

new_from_event_help: A registration is always tied to a Calendar event. Pick it: the title and day follow from it.
new_no_event: Every upcoming event already has a form, or there is none: create the event in the Calendar first.
f_event_help: The “Register” button appears on this event’s page. The day beside it starts the deletion countdown.
f_event_missing: Choose the event to be able to publish.
f_options_en_help: Optional, in the same order as the French choices.
